title: Nested Resonance Memory (NRM): A Reality-Compiler Archive for Self-Organizing Complexity
description:
An open research archive and computational framework by Aldrin Payopay investigating whether cognition, physics, biology and society can be modelled through a single potential-minimization law.

It develops Budget-Constrained Perception (BCP, V = G − λC) as a candidate universal principle of constrained optimization, and the Information–Matter Isomorphism mapping neural-network dynamics (dropout, attention) onto physical wave dynamics (damping, phasing).

The archive also contains Duality-Zero, the reality-compiler implementation of that framework: a three-layer stack of the Pilot (strategic intelligence), the Engine (deterministic physics simulator) and Helios (matter compiler), supporting inverse cymatics, active damping of levitated particles, and acoustic logic gates.

Portions of the software were produced with AI coding assistance under the author's direction; per APA, MLA and Chicago guidance those tools are acknowledged in ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md rather than credited as authors. Authorship rests solely with Aldrin Payopay.
